origin: Short project-authored editorial notes of first-hand publication observations already reviewed in Phase118. NOT original article bytes, not automatically authenticated, not new independent testing.

passages.text: The Roborock Saros Rover was observed at IFA 2026 negotiating a staircase and cleaning stair treads. This was an exhibition demonstration, not a multi-week household reliability test.

eufy MarsWalker is a tracked carrier that can transport a compatible cleaning robot upstairs; it does not vacuum individual stair treads. This manufacturer description is not an independent household test.

The independent original review of Roborock Saros 20 reports traversing a single threshold of 57 millimetres after repositioning. This does not show it can climb a domestic staircase or reliably clear every threshold.
